name: 28-background-clip-origin
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } div { padding: 14px; border: 6px dashed #3366cc; margin: 10px 0; font-size: 13px; } .cc { background-color: #ff0000; background-clip: content-box; } .pc { background-color: #00aa00; background-clip: padding-box; } .bc { background-color: #0000aa; background-clip: border-box; color: #fff; }
html:
content-box 裁切：底色只铺内容盒
padding-box 裁切：底色铺到内边距外沿
border-box 裁切：底色铺到边框外沿
